heading: Seeing change from orbit.
body: Multi-temporal satellite imagery turned into measurable change — classification, spectral indices, and time-series analysis at landscape scale in Google Earth Engine.

heading: Where people and landscapes meet.
body: Modeling how development, disturbance, and policy reshape land cover, with a focus on wildfire risk in the wildland–urban interface.

heading: Uncertainty, stated honestly.
body: Bayesian and spatial-statistical models that quantify what the data actually support, in reproducible pipelines anyone can rerun.

heading: Models that reach a decision-maker.
body: Machine learning applied to ecological and geospatial problems, paired with visualization that makes the result legible to non-specialists.

heading: Mapping what lives where.
body: Species distribution models and habitat mapping that turn scattered occurrence records into conservation-planning inputs.

heading: Infrastructure for spatial work.
body: Spatial databases, automated data pipelines, and open-source GIS tooling that keep analysis fast, current, and shareable.
